anti_patterns.name: Segment Mixing
anti_patterns.symptom: One customer profile for many segments at once — jobs/pains/gains become an average that isn’t accurate for anyone

anti_patterns.name: Feature Dump
anti_patterns.symptom: A list of products/features is referred to as 'value' without explaining which pain is relieved or which gain is created

anti_patterns.name: Address Everything
anti_patterns.symptom: Mencoba menyelesaikan semua pains/gains customer sekaligus — tidak fokus, tidak unggul di satu pun

anti_patterns.name: Spreadsheet Fantasy
anti_patterns.symptom: Business plan/spreadsheet detail tanpa eksperimen lapangan — 'completely made up and turned out to be wrong'
